_comment: These are PUBLIC keys. Publishing them is the point: a stranger who
clones this repository can verify any record we issue without asking
us for anything, and without trusting the key the record carries.
`evidence verify` checks a record's signature against THIS file and
nothing else. A record that encloses its own public key is not
verified by it -- a forger encloses a key too. Only a key listed here
can produce a record that verifies.
The matching private keys live outside this repository and are never
committed. `evidence keygen` refuses to write one inside the tree.
Retiring a key: set status to 'retired' and leave the entry in place.
Removing it would invalidate every record it ever issued, which is the
opposite of what an evidence archive is for. A retired key still
verifies its historical records; it must not be used to issue new ones.

keys.note: Ashforde OU conformance issuing key. Records issued by this key carry issued.by = ashforde-conformance.
